unitDialogue.signature: [1,[{"id":"L29-D01","person":"Jones","who":"teacher","text":"Come in, Amy.","cn":"进来，艾米。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页58–61（PDF91–94）；Lesson29原文"},{"id":"L29-D02","person":"Jones","who":"teacher","text":"Shut the door, please.","cn":"请把门关上。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页58–61（PDF91–94）；Lesson29原文"},{"id":"L29-D03","person":"Jones","who":"teacher","text":"This bedroom's very untidy.","cn":"这间卧室很不整齐。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页58–61（PDF91–94）；Lesson29原文"},{"id":"L29-D04","person":"Amy","who":"student","text":"What must I do, Mrs. Jones?","cn":"我应该做些什么呢，琼斯太太？","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页58–61（PDF91–94）；Lesson29原文"},{"id":"L29-D05","person":"Jones","who":"teacher","text":"Open the window and air the room.","cn":"打开窗户，给房间通通风。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页58–61（PDF91–94）；Lesson29原文"},{"id":"L29-D06","person":"Jones","who":"teacher","text":"Then put these clothes in the wardrobe.","cn":"然后把这些衣服放进衣柜里。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页58–61（PDF91–94）；Lesson29原文"},{"id":"L29-D07","person":"Jones","who":"teacher","text":"Then make the bed.","cn":"接着整理床铺。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页58–61（PDF91–94）；Lesson29原文"},{"id":"L29-D08","person":"Jones","who":"teacher","text":"Dust the dressing table.","cn":"掸掉梳妆台上的灰尘。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页58–61（PDF91–94）；Lesson29原文"},{"id":"L29-D09","person":"Jones","who":"teacher","text":"Then sweep the floor.","cn":"然后扫地。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页58–61（PDF91–94）；Lesson29原文"}]]
